info.title: Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024: Divorce rates (divorces and annulments per 1,000 residents, by state of occurrence) and marriage rates for every state that reports them to the CDC's National Center for Health Statistics, for 1990, 1995 and each year 2000 to 2024, with each reporting state's latest rate, its 2019 rate and its rate in 2000 (or its first reported year after 2000) and the change since; and the national provisional counts of divorces and marriages each year since 2000, with the states the national divorce count leaves out. Rates and counts only, as NCHS publishes them.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
